coaching_overview: This 4-week Base Building block progresses from 38 km (Week 1) to a peak of 44 km (Week 3), followed by recovery at 34 km (Week 4). The plan respects your 7-hour weekly time budget while maintaining an 80/20 intensity split (80% easy aerobic runs, 20% hard tempo/interval sessions). Two quality sessions per week (tempo on Saturday, intervals on Tuesday) develop lactate threshold and VO2 max while abundant easy runs build aerobic capacity. The long run grows systematically from 14 km (Week 1) to a peak of 17 km (Week 3), never exceeding 2 km growth per week. Current training paces (easy 6:15 /km, tempo 5:30 /km) are derived from your recent Strava data and applied consistently throughout. Week 4 reduces volume 23% to consolidate adaptations, preparing for the next block. No race date is set — after this block, you can select a target race and transition into Aerobic Development (weeks 5–8) and Peak Training (weeks 9–12) phases. Expect to feel noticeably stronger in aerobic endurance and threshold power by block end.
